stories.title: Lock Schema with TTL, Ownership, and Versioning
stories.description: Define and implement the Brain lock document schema including owner_id, lock_acquired_at, expires_at (TTL), and version for optimistic concurrency control. Ensure compatibility with MongoDB TTL indexing.

stories.title: Lock Renewal (Heartbeat) Mechanism
stories.description: Implement periodic lock renewal (heartbeat) logic that extends TTL for active owners while preventing extension by non-owners. Include safeguards against lost heartbeats and partial failures.

stories.title: Lock Management API (Acquire, Renew, Release)
stories.description: Expose internal service methods or endpoints for lock acquire, renew, and release operations with strict ownership validation and atomic updates to prevent race conditions.

stories.title: Lock Observability and Audit Logging
stories.description: Add structured logging and audit trails for lock lifecycle events (acquire, renew, expire, override) including owner identity and timestamps to support debugging and governance review.

stories.title: Failure Injection and Recovery Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop integration tests simulating worker crashes, missed heartbeats, and concurrent acquisition under TTL expiry to validate recovery correctness and system stability.
